Edinburgh Street Reopens After Major Fire Destroys Historic Building

Princes Street in Edinburgh has reopened following a major fire that gutted a historic building. The fire necessitated the closure of the city centre street. Emergency services worked to contain the blaze. The reopening aims to signal a return to normal operations in the affected area.
